title: conceptual and intellectual framework of the economic policy uncertainty field: a bibliometric analysis
core_idea: This study performs a bibliometric analysis of the economic policy uncertainty (EPU) literature (2006–2022) using Scopus-sourced publications to map the field's knowledge structure and examine its conceptual and intellectual framework via tools such as VOSviewer and Biblioshiny, aiming to identify characteristics, hot topics, and emerging research avenues relevant to researchers and policymakers.
tldr: A bibliometric mapping of EPU literature (2006–2022) from Scopus to reveal the field's knowledge structure and highlight areas for future research, using VOSviewer and Biblioshiny.
